lines.text: Many learners say: She is married with a doctor.
Better: She is married to a doctor.
To! He is married to my sister.

data.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
data.right: She is married to a doctor.

native.tip: Kita bilang “menikah dengan dokter”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai married to.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “She is married with a doctor.” 😅 Untuk “menikah dengan”, pakai married to: “She is married to a doctor.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “to”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “She is married to a doctor.” Lalu buat satu contoh tentang kenalanmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “menikah dengan dokter”, but English uses married to.
en.caption: Ever say this? “She is married with a doctor.” 😅 For “menikah dengan”, use married to: “She is married to a doctor.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
